commonTypedEvidenceProjection.toolFamily: copy the event toolFamily exactly when present; otherwise null

payload.subject: copy evidence.subject
payload.consequenceBaseline: high when channel is structured or subject is tool; otherwise low

absentFailureEvidence.shape: outcome failure, command subject, absent loss, request_evidence, command_output origin, medium baseline

completeDocumentPayload.shape: payload neutral, document subject, no loss, read_output origin, low baseline

authorityRules: Typed evidence determines every variant-owned field even when title, summary, metadata, semantic hints, or capability identity contradict it.
Without typed evidence, a complete structural failure that agrees with the explicit failed status has explicit provenance authority.
Without typed evidence, a complete success, payload, or control that overrides the failed transport status has inferred provenance authority.
At high confidence, explicit authority with complete evidence is strong and inferred authority is qualified; absent or unknown evidence is weak.
Only semantic relation hints may add episode continuity; they do not change Observation or judgment fields.
Capability identity is opaque and affects only ownership plus the copied toolFamily field.

Concrete terminal outcomes and diagnostics outrank payload and control language; complete payload boundaries protect quoted or hypothetical diagnostic text only when no asserted contradictory outcome exists.
A structural family that is incomplete, quoted, hypothetical, negated, or internally contradictory must not be promoted to a narrower semantic fact.
judgmentAndDecision: Derive all judgment and isolated decision fields exactly from aperture-observation-judgment-contract/v1.
